probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Skip to content Dario Castelli Architect, Milan Close Projects About Journal Contact [email protected] LinkedIn Instagram Overview Printing wood into concrete Date 12 June 2025 Topic Materials Length 1 min read Next: A loggia is a room Board-marked concrete is usually poured against pine planks that end up in a skip. At Casa Lario we used the larch that would later clad the house instead. Why larch Larch is resinous and slightly uneven. Pressed against wet concrete, it leaves a deeper, more irregular grain than pine, and each board leaves a slightly different print. What it cost The boards had to be planed on one side only, used once and then cleaned and dried for six weeks before going on the facade. It added a month to the programme. Standing in the living room, nobody has asked whether it was worth it. © 2026 Dario Castelli Milan, --:-- Terms Privacy Cookies Overview
